title: Pločnik: technology of metal production
version: The Rise of Metallurgy in Eurasia, Archaeopress, chapter 26, pp. 301–316
lineage: Repository metadata and full facsimile at https://www.academia.edu/69498047/Ch26_Radivojevi%C4%87_Rehren_Plo%C4%8Dnik_technology_of_metal_production_from_Radivojevi%C4%87_Roberts_et_al_2021_The_Rise_of_Metallurgy_in_Eurasia. Original finds from the 2012–2013 excavations.

passages.note: Copper ring C_P2/13 was found at Trench 24, spit 9, Horizon 1, associated with Feature 3. The associated sample MAMS22081 dates to 4493–4365 cal BCE (2σ).

Figure 12 documents annealing twins and slip lines in C_P2/13. The ring is one of several high-purity copper artefacts. P10/13 is a distinct copper foil, separate from the earlier tin-bronze foil reported in 2013. The broader new assemblage supports secondary processing at Pločnik.
